# Light group (`light-group`)

A master switch and brightness for a group of lights that expands to each member.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createLightGroup` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/lightGroup.d.ts`): `.mh-light-group` (on a lit `.mh-control-card` frame, states `.is-on`, `.is-expanded`): a master switch in the trailing slot (on while any member is on; switching it sets every member), a master brightness slider (`__level`, the average of the lights that are on), and a disclosure button (`__expand`, `aria-expanded`) that shows `__members`, one `.mh-light-control` per light.

```ts
export function createLightGroup(options: LightGroupOptions): LightGroupHandle;

export interface LightGroupOptions {
  /** The group's name ("Kitchen"); also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  members: readonly LightGroupMember[];
  /** Show each member (default false); the expander changes it. */
  expanded?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<LightGroupLabels>;
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** The master switch: every member on or off. */
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** The master brightness, sent on release: every dimmable member to this level. */
  onBrightness?: (value: number) => void;
  onMemberToggle?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void;
  onMemberBrightness?: (id: string, value: number) => void;
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void;
}

export interface LightGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<LightGroupOptions>): void;
  /** Sends dragged values that were never released. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible word, for translation. */
export interface LightGroupLabels {
  /** The state line: "2 of 4 on · 60%". `brightness` is null when no light that is on dims. */
  summary(on: number, total: number, brightness: number | null): string;
  /** The master switch's accessible name: "All lights in Kitchen". */
  all(group: string): string;
  brightness: string;
  /** The expander: "Show 4 lights". */
  show(count: number): string;
  hide: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createLightGroup, type LightGroupMember } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let members: LightGroupMember[] = [
  { id: 'pendants', name: 'Pendants', on: true, brightness: 80 },
  { id: 'counter', name: 'Counter strip', on: true, brightness: 40 },
  { id: 'spots', name: 'Spots', on: false, brightness: 0 },
];

// A null id changes every light in the group.
const change = (id: string | null, patch: Partial<LightGroupMember>): void => {
  members = members.map((m) => (id === null || m.id === id ? { ...m, ...patch } : m));
  group.update({ members });
};

const group = createLightGroup({
  name: 'Kitchen',
  members,
  onToggle: (on) => change(null, { on }),
  onBrightness: (brightness) => change(null, { brightness, on: brightness > 0 }),
  onMemberToggle: (id, on) => change(id, { on }),
  onMemberBrightness: (id, brightness) => change(id, { brightness, on: brightness > 0 }),
});

document.body.append(group.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { LightGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { LightGroupMember } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function LightGroupExample() {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<LightGroupMember[]>([
    { id: 'pendants', name: 'Pendants', on: true, brightness: 80 },
    { id: 'counter', name: 'Counter strip', on: true, brightness: 40 },
    { id: 'spots', name: 'Spots', on: false, brightness: 0 },
  ]);
  // A null id changes every light in the group.
  const change = (id: string | null, patch: Partial<LightGroupMember>) =>
    setMembers((list) => list.map((m) => (id === null || m.id === id ? { ...m, ...patch } : m)));
  return (
    <LightGroup
      name="Kitchen"
      members={members}
      onToggle={(on) => change(null, { on })}
      onBrightness={(brightness) => change(null, { brightness, on: brightness > 0 })}
      onMemberToggle={(id, on) => change(id, { on })}
      onMemberBrightness={(id, brightness) => change(id, { brightness, on: brightness > 0 })}
    />
  );
}
```
